summary: Project structural-connectome module membership onto zebrafish brain anatomy — plot the bilateral Mapzebrain region centroids as coloured nodes over the atlas top (XY) and side projections, one colour per consensus-Louvain module, to show where each module sits along the anterior-posterior axis.
use_when: Run the Module topography on atlas projections recipe

avoid_when: A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
